{{disambig|Tank}}

==Enemies==
'''Tank''' may refer to these enemies:
*[[Fallen Tank]], a fast, high health enemy that first appears on Wave 36 in [[Fallen Mode|Fallen]] mode
**[[Fallen Tank/Advanced Stats]]
*[[Tanker]], a semi-fast, high health enemy that first appears on Wave 31 in [[Molten Mode|Molten]] mode


It can also refer to these removed enemies:
*[[Tank]], a fast, high health enemy that first appears on Wave 30 in [[Golden Mode|Golden]] mode, [[Legacy Fallen Mode|Legacy Fallen]] mode and in the [[Juggernaut (Challenge)|Juggernaut]], [[Jailed Towers (Challenge)|Jailed Towers]], [[Legion (Challenge)|Legion]] and [[Vanguard (Challenge)|Vanguard]] challenges
**[[Tank/Advanced Stats]]
*[[Tank 2]], a high health enemy that threw boulders at towers, which first appeared on Wave 46 prior to the [[Release v1.0|MEGA Update]]

It can also refer to these event enemies:
*[[Frost Tank]], a high health enemy that threw boulders at towers, which first appeared on Wave 13 in [[Village of Despair]]

==Units==
'''Tank''' may refer to these units:
*[[Railgun Tank]], a unit spawned by the Level 5 [[Military Base]]
**[[Railgun Tank/Gallery]]
*[[Tank (Unit)]], a unit spawned by the Level 4 [[Military Base]]
**[[Tank (Unit)/Gallery]]
